canonical_statement: For a compact locally contractible subspace A of the n-sphere and every degree i below n, reduced cohomology of A in degree i is naturally isomorphic to reduced homology of its complement in degree n - i - 1, with a fixed coefficient system.
domain_and_universes: provisionally n i : Nat; A : Set (TopCat.sphere n); coefficient category/object to be frozen by the statement phase
hypotheses: a single coefficient system is used on both sides
conclusion: a natural isomorphism between reduced cohomology of A in degree i and reduced homology of S^n minus A in degree n - i - 1

alternate_encodings.target: arbitrary compact A with reduced Cech cohomology
alternate_encodings.checked_witness: none; excluded from the canonical root until an exact Lean Cech theory is selected

alternate_encodings.relationship: expected transport along S^n as the one-point compactification
statement-shape discovery artifact, not logically equivalent as presently defined
alternate_encodings.checked_witness: none; explicitly ineligible for root proof credit

excluded_degenerate_cases: Empty/full A, n = 0, and i >= n require explicit reduced-group and integer-grading conventions; they are boundary probes rather than silently covered Nat-subtraction cases.
